confdir.description: Configuration directory for keys and certificates.

ca_url.description: ACMEv2 server directory object URL. Leave empty to use default based on staging_mode.

staging_mode.description: Use Let's Encrypt staging URL for testing.

acme_account_email.description: Email contact for the ACME account.

key_type.description: Key type for newly generated keys: RSA or EC.

key_bits.description: Key bit length. 2048-8192 for RSA, 256 or 384 for EC.

external_account_binding.description: RFC8555 External Account Binding credentials in KEYID:KEY format.

days_until_reissue.description: Do not reissue certificates valid for longer than this many days.

disable_ari.description: Do not query or use the server's certificate renewal information window.

must_staple.description: Request certificates with the OCSP Must-Staple extension.

hook_program.description: Challenge hook program path. Empty string disables hook.
